subject: Storix overspill settlement & one-time amnesty
messages:
From: Emily Park <emily@storix.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Mike Holden <mike.holden@storix.com>
Date: Sun, 31 May 2026 14:08:00 -0700
Subject: Unexpected May usage — need help

Hi Rachel,

We found a significant spike in our May inference usage after we pushed a large batch import on May 18. Our committed capacity was exceeded for several days and the attached usage report shows ~18% over committed units for the month. Billing flagged a one-time overage charge — the team is asking whether Redwood can help us reconcile this and whether theres any room for a one-time credit.

Key items:
- Attached: storix-usage-may2026.csv (raw calls + per-model token breakdown)
- We were on the 12k-unit dedicated plan (monthly) — spike happened 5/18-5/22 during a migration.
- Looking for an amortized settlement or a one-off credit so this doesnt derail our renewal conversation next week.

Can we schedule a quick call tomorrow to discuss options?

Thanks,
Emily Park
Head of Platform | Storix, Inc.
From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
To: Emily Park <emily@storix.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Jun 2026 09:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Unexpected May usage — need help

Emily — thanks for the heads up and for the CSV. Ive pulled this into a quick pass-through and looped in Ben (AE) and Laura (finance) to help with the reconciliation and any billing adjustments.

Short answer: we can do a retrospective settlement. Options we typically offer are:
1) One-time invoice for the exact overage (fast, standard)
2) Amortized settlement (spread the one-time charge across next N invoices)
3) Partial amnesty (we absorb a percentage of the overage) tied to a committed term change (e.g., 12-month expansion)

Given this is a migration-induced spike, Id propose we:
- Run a final validation on the attached CSV (Laura)
- Offer Storix a one-time 40% amnesty on the overage if you sign a 12-month capacity uplift (details below)
- Apply remaining amount as a one-off invoice or split across the next 2 invoices (your preference)

Proposed next steps: 30-minute call tomorrow 10:00–10:30 PT, Laura to confirm numbers, Ben to draft amendment language. Does that work?

Thanks,
Rachel Kim
Sr. AM, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference — developer-first inference platform
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>, Emily Park <emily@storix.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Jun 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Unexpected May usage — need help

Emily / team — thanks for taking the call today. Quick recap and the mutual action plan (MAP) we agreed on:

MAP items:
- Redwood to validate raw usage and confirm final overage amount by EOD Thu 6/4 (Laura)
- Storix to confirm go-forward capacity commitment (proposed +15% to current plan) by 6/7
- If Storix signs 12-month uplift amendment (DEAL-4591), Redwood will apply a one-time amnesty of 40% of the validated overage, and the remainder will be invoiced as a one-off charge or split over next 2 invoices (Storix preference).
- Redwood will provide a redline-ready amendment and a DocuSign link by 6/5.

Attached: redwood-amnesty-proposal.pdf (proposal + sample amendment language).

Emily — can you confirm whether you prefer the one-off invoice or split billing? If youd like the split, indicate 2 or 3 months.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Mike Holden <mike.holden@storix.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>, Emily Park <emily@storix.com>
Date: Thu, 4 Jun 2026 08:51:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Unexpected May usage — need help

Thanks for the MAP, Ben. We ran the numbers in our ledger — validated overage = $18,360 (computed from tokens and model weights in the CSV).

Storix position: were comfortable with the 12-month uplift (wed bump committed capacity +15% starting July 1), but the team wants a larger amnesty to avoid impacting this quarters forecast. Our ask is: 50% amnesty + remaining balance applied as a credit across the next two monthly invoices. Wed sign the amendment with that condition.

If youre firm at 40% well need a small discount on the uplifted commitment price for the first 3 months.

Can Laura send a final invoice stub showing both scenarios (40% amnesty vs 50% amnesty + credit) so we can route through procurement quickly?

— Mike
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Mike Holden <mike.holden@storix.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2026 16:22:00 -0700
Subject: Final settlement options & invoice stubs

Mike / team — attaching invoice stubs as requested: storix-invoice-may2026.pdf (scenario A = 40% amnesty, one-off invoice for remaining $11,016) and storix-invoice-may2026-scenarioB.pdf (50% amnesty with remaining $9,180 applied as credit split across next 2 invoices).

Summary, validated overage = $18,360
- Scenario A: 40% amnesty ($7,344) -> bill $11,016 as one-off invoice due Net30
- Scenario B: 50% amnesty ($9,180) -> remaining $9,180 credited across July + August invoices ($4,590/month) + sign 12-month +15% uplift amendment as of 2026-07-01

If Storix confirms Scenario B, we will:
- Send DocuSign for amendment and DocuSign for adjusted invoice/credit acknowledgement by EOD 6/7
- Apply credit automatically when July invoice is generated (no manual allocation required on your side)

Emily — please confirm which scenario youre approving and well push the DocuSigns. Once signed, the finance team will finalize the invoice IDs and send a single consolidated PDF for your records.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Finance Manager, Redwood Inference

Storix Billing (external reply)

Emily
